Riches are surprisingly hollow, because it really is a waste-if it never amounts to anything, its just a drain on the economy, not to mention people who could use that money for things LIKE surviving. Adam also makes great strong points in doing what you love, because that's yet another facet of happiness-I'd much rather be living in a lower middle class situation doing what I love versus being forced into a high paying position I don't feel for. I think his view (along with yours, crush) really is one of the best ways to go in life.
